# Reviewed learning module

Only the current release named in `module-release.json` is kept here. Its original Git blob is verified by the build checks. Source geometry and learning UI live in `../module/`. Older snapshots and the `previousRelease` provenance field refer to the history archive: [archive/digital-before-cleanup-20261106](https://github.com/unDead41/geoMathDigital/tree/archive/digital-before-cleanup-20261106/digital/vendor).
